item.title: Keith Foskey, Michael Foster, & Seth Gruber: Nothing but Fun Episode! [Dead Men Walking Podcast]
item.description:

This week Greg sat down with Keith Foskey, Michael Foster, & Seth Gruber while attending the Dangerous Friends Conference. This has been labeled as the "Nothing but Fun" episode, as Greg discussed comedy and their favorite stand ups with Keith, while Michael and Seth sat in for a segment of "Fresh 10", where Greg asked ten rapid fire unknown personal questions to get to know the guest a little bit more. Have fun, and enjoy!

item.title: Josiah Stowe: Trump Tariffs, Inflation, and How To Prepare [Dead Men Walking Podcast]
item.description:
Send us a text

This week Greg sat down with Josiah Stowe. Josiah is the owner of Dominion Wealth Strategists. They discussed the affect the "Trump Tariffs" as well as inflation in general will have on the average american, as well as small business. They discussed a pragmatic approach to investing and real estate in the current economy, the sinfulness of an income tax, and questioned what economic laws they would institute under their version of theonomy. Enjoy!
